title: Sirloin Kebabs with Ukrainian Twist
description: A hearty and flavorful sirloin kebab recipe with a tangy Ukrainian twist, featuring a velvety sauce.

ingredients.name: Ukrainian kebab sauce (tangy)
ingredients.notes: Available in most Eastern European stores

instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. Cut the sirloin steak into 1-inch cubes.
3. Thread the sirloin cubes, vegetables, and Ukrainian kebab sauce onto skewers.
4. Brush the kebabs with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
5. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
6. Meanwhile, heat the remaining Ukrainian kebab sauce in a saucepan over low heat.
7. Serve the grilled kebabs with the warm Ukrainian kebab sauce.
8. Garnish with fresh parsley or dill, if desired.
